text: dude im going to lose my mind the map painter just locks up the wasd movement and f8 doesnt do jack fucking shit i cant drag the map ar ound or do anything im gridlocked half the time
resolution: Root-caused the map painter gridlock: the engine has a built-in Canvas.Node click-to-select (engine.zig background-click path) and paintCanvasContainer FREEZES drift — the WASD pan — whenever a node is selected. Every chunk surface in the painter IS a Canvas.Node, so any click that missed an interactive handler silently toggled a phantom selection: WASD dead until another click toggled it off (the 'half the time' lockup). F8 was powerless because it only bypasses the JS typing gate; the freeze lived host-side. Fix: new Canvas prop selectNodes={false} (layout.canvas_node_select) — skips the click-select toggle, the hover/selected rings, and the drift-freeze check; PaintCanvas sets it. Bundle-checked + zig ast-check clean; NEEDS A ZIG REBUILD to take effect.
